panel_descriptions.neg_0: A rounded circle-beaded loop at upper left and an angular square-beaded loop at lower right overlap around a compact central tangle; a triangle-beaded strand also passes through the overlap.
panel_descriptions.neg_1: Several differently rendered strands form a bent assembly: two long solid segments descend from a short row of circles, while triangle and square chains branch near the bend and a broad curved stroke runs underneath.
panel_descriptions.neg_2: One large circular ring is assembled from successive circle, square, triangle, zigzag, and smooth-stroke sections.
panel_descriptions.neg_3: One irregular oval ring is assembled from square-beaded, smooth, circle-beaded, zigzag, and thick dark sections.
panel_descriptions.neg_4: A small multibranch figure combines an upper angular arc, two neighboring zigzag descents, and a lower rounded circle chain; its lobed regions have visibly unequal outlines and extents.
panel_descriptions.neg_5: Two triangle-beaded loops attach around a central junction and form a stacked, bent double-loop figure with visibly unequal lobe shapes and sizes.
panel_descriptions.pos_0: Zigzag, triangle-beaded, and square-beaded strands interweave into two similarly shaped slender lobes on opposing sides of a compact middle junction.
panel_descriptions.pos_1: A single angular outline crosses at its center to form two similarly sized triangular lobes, one toward the upper left and one toward the lower right.
panel_descriptions.pos_2: A horizontal angular outline forms two matching diamond-shaped lobes that meet at one central point and extend left and right.
panel_descriptions.pos_3: Two matching pointed kite-like lobes meet through a small central junction and extend toward the lower left and upper right.
panel_descriptions.pos_4: A sharply angular crossed outline forms two matching narrow triangular lobes extending toward the upper right and lower left around one center.
panel_descriptions.pos_5: Circle-beaded and zigzag or solid sections trace two similarly scaled loop-like lobes joined at a compact central crossing and extending into opposing sectors.
